title: Best Catalog Designers (2026): Product Catalogs and Lookbooks
description: How to hire a catalog designer for product catalogs, lookbooks or price lists: layouts, files, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Catalog designers arrange products, photos, descriptions and specifications into clear printed or digital catalogs, lookbooks and line sheets. A good catalog helps buyers find products quickly and makes your range look professional. Projects go wrong when product data is incomplete or changes during design, photos are low quality, or the file is not prepared for printing. This guide helps you get a catalog that sells.

faq.a: Print suits trade shows and mail. Digital PDFs are easy to send and update. Many businesses use both, designed from the same files.

faq.q: How do I send product information?
faq.a: A spreadsheet with product names, codes, descriptions, sizes and prices, plus photos named with the product codes, saves time and errors.

faq.q: Can I update it later myself?
faq.a: Ask for editable source files and a template. Some designers set up layouts that can be updated by changing data.

faq.q: What makes a catalog easy to use?
faq.a: Clear sections, consistent product layouts, readable text and a contents page or index.

faq.q: Who checks the prices and specs?
faq.a: You do. Designers copy what you send, so proofread every product detail before printing.
